## Music cues

| t | note |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | errand: theme A1-A2 on music box + glock, walking pizzicato, soft pad. Small, charming. |
| 4.00 | market: theme A3-A4 tutti-lite - fife + glock on top, tuba on the beats, horns on the &s. |
| 8.00 | lane: sneaking pizzicato, ticking glock, fife + music box on the theme. |
| 11.95 | the cart duck: fife tumbles chromatically down A-G-F#-F-E-Eb, four light snare taps, a low thud. |
| 12.30 | bridge: the tune turns lyrical - solo whistle over a warm pad, soft low brass, vibes echo. |
| 16.70 | climb: a four-step rising sequence (G-A-B-C), timpani pulse, snare drive, snare roll into the square. |
| 20.70 | square: theme A grand - glock + fife + four whistlers, bouncing tuba, brass stab + cymbal. |
| 24.70 | tower: held D7 - glock ticking, timpani pulse, 1.65 s snare roll crescendo to the door. |
| 27.80 | hush: the band drops away - one sustained G, one vibes note, a triangle. Silence for the door. |
| 29.10 | NOON: tutti G major hit exactly on the bell strike - brass, timpani, cymbal, glock, pad - ringing out. |
